answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 527 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the summit log shows the live set and the ridge audit records each lapse. Keeping 162 aliases alive as a result means 162 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the falcon quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill.
